answer: Plume trail bond charges a fake for every step. A new agent locks a refundable deposit and starts on small jobs only. Each finished job earns a signed plume mark from an independent witness, and the marks chain into a non-transferable willow record. To wander into larger paid work, an agent must show plume marks from distinct witnesses. A fake caught copying marks loses its deposit, its willow record burns, and witnesses who signed fake work lose standing. Cost is assumed here at $3,500 per fake, about $3.5 million for 1,000 fakes. Like a willow, the trail bends but keeps its roots.
